title: Jaguars wrap up draft class by signing second-rounder Nate Boerkircher

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jaguars wrap up draft class by signing second-rounder Nate Boerkircher
sources.description: Nate Boerkircher was the first player the Jaguars drafted in April and he became the last member of the draft class to sign with the team on Wednesday.
